These compact MusicBrainz search snapshots reproduce incorrect cover choices for
Metallica / Whiskey in the Jar and Michael Jackson / Human Nature.

Captured 2026-10-19 from https://musicbrainz.org/ws/2/recording/ using public search.
Nonessential fields and unrelated later results have been removed. The original
ordering of retained results is preserved, including incorrect early live/video
or compilation matches and the later studio album recordings.

Tests use these local fixtures without contacting MusicBrainz or Cover Art Archive.
